```{r site-header, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
logo_html <- paste(readLines("assets/logo.html", warn = FALSE), collapse = "")
# Same navigation as index.qmd: the Photos link appears only when gallery/ has images
has_gallery <- length(list.files("gallery", pattern = "\\.(jpe?g|png|webp|gif)$", ignore.case = TRUE)) > 0
nav <- c(Research = "index.html#research", Publications = "publications.html", People = "index.html#people")
if (has_gallery) nav <- c(nav, Photos = "index.html#photos")
nav <- c(nav, Contact = "index.html#contact")
current <- ifelse(names(nav) == "Publications", ' aria-current="page"', "")
cat(
  '\n```{=html}\n<header class="site">\n  <div class="wrap hdr">\n',
  '    <a class="lab" href="index.html">', logo_html, '</a>\n',
  '    <nav aria-label="Primary">',
  paste0('<a href="', nav, '"', current, '>', names(nav), '</a>', collapse = ""),
  '</nav>\n  </div>\n</header>\n```\n\n',
  sep = ""
)
```
